description: This file contains functions for upgrading firmware images on a GL.iNet device, including extraction of UBI images from FIT images and validation of firmware images before upgrade.

methods.name: glinet_do_fit_upgrade
methods.description: Extracts a UBI image from a FIT image and performs the upgrade if the checksum matches.

methods.name: glinet_do_upgrade
methods.description: Validates the firmware image and initiates the upgrade process, choosing between FIT image handling and default sysupgrade.
